title_sq: Tek Myslym Shyri, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Per Investim !!
description_sq: Ne fillim te "Myslym Shyri-t" shitet apartament 2+1, me siperfaqe totale 115m/2, nga te cilat 90 m2 jane ne certifikate dhe 25 m2 jane shtese ne proces legalizimi, ne katin e pare te nje pallati te ndertuar ne vitin 1991. Apartamenti ka strukture mjaft te rregullt dhe ambjente me hapsira te bollshme. Ai eshte i organizuar ne 1 korridor hyres qe ben ndarjen e ambjentve te tjera. Ne te djathte eshte salloni bashke me kendin e gatimit i cili eshte me vete, ne krahun e majte ndodhet dy dhomat e gjumit, ku dhoma matrimoniale ka dalje ne ballkon, si dhe nje tualet te bollshem me dritare. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte Jug-Perendim cka ofron nje ndricim natyral shume te mire gjate gjithe dites. Apartamenti shitet totalisht i arreduar, sic shikohet dhe ne fotot ilustruese. Per shkak te vendodhjes ne nje nga zonat me te preferuara te Tiranes dhe faktit qe ndodhet ne katin e pare te jep mundesine per ta pershtatur ne ambjent per biznese te ndryshme.
title_en: In Myslym Shyri, 2+1 apartment for sale for investment!!
description_en: At the beginning of "Myslym Shyri", a 2+1 apartment is for sale, with a total area of ​​115 m/2, of which 90 m2 are in certificates and 25 m2 are additions in the process of legalization, on the first floor of a building built in 1991. The apartment has a very regular structure and spacious rooms. It is organized in 1 entrance corridor that separates the other areas. On the right is the living room with its own kitchen, on the left are the two bedrooms, where the master bedroom has access to the balcony, as well as a spacious bathroom with a window. The orientation of the apartment is South-West, which offers a very good natural lighting throughout the day. The apartment is sold fully furnished, as seen in the illustrative photos. Due to its location in one of the most preferred areas of Tirana and the fact that it is located on the first floor, it gives the opportunity to adapt it to the environment for various businesses.
